title: Note-taking product feature overlap
goal: A product team can see unique and shared note-taking capabilities.

rubric.must: Three labelled product sets visibly overlap.
The central overlap visibly labels Tags and search.
Pairwise feature overlaps are visibly labelled.
Each product has a visible unique feature.

ideal.notes: Independently authored using visual-eval/exemplars/venn/venn/ideal.svg (07e0f59e6164); rendered and visually reviewed. Three equal translucent circles; every exclusive, pairwise and triple region is labelled inside its exact region, with clearance from boundaries. No areas or counts invented.
